The company decided to launch a sub-chain called "Victory CITY". The company's goal is to open up to 50 stores of the sub-chain throughout Gush Dan in sizes of up to 300 square meters by the end of 2023. The company estimates the sales of the sub-chain at an annual volume of approximately 500 million NIS per year starting in 2024. According to the company, the establishment of the sub-chain is expected to significantly improve the company's gross profit and profitability. Financing the establishment of the sub-chain and its current operations is supposed to come from the company's own sources, when the company will also examine the acquisition of the activities of existing stores that will be suitable for the activities of the new sub-chain.
